description: System sessions are not configured to lock or terminate after a period of inactivity. This signal indicates that idle sessions remain active indefinitely without requiring re-authentication, potentially allowing unauthorized access to unattended systems.
applicability: Applicable to workstations, servers, cloud consoles, applications, and any system where user sessions are established. Includes operating system screen lock policies, web application session timeouts, SSH session configurations, and remote desktop settings.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of group policy settings, session timeout configurations, screen lock policies, and application session management parameters.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
